name: Atlas News Intelligence
description: Evidence-backed geographic news intelligence over live records, with explicit uncertainty and source comparison.

capabilities.name: Query Dominant Stories
capabilities.description: Query current story clusters by event region, time window, and raw or normalized prominence.

capabilities.name: Explain Story Cluster
capabilities.description: Return cluster membership, source articles, event-location evidence, claims, and regional prominence.

capabilities.name: Compare Regional Coverage
capabilities.description: Compare raw and source-volume-normalized prominence without conflating publisher origin and event location.

capabilities.name: Inspect Pipeline Health
capabilities.description: Inspect source watermark, freshness, failure state, and retryability before using results.

eval_suites.name: geolocation-fidelity
criteria: Event locations have coordinates, type, confidence, and source evidence.
Publisher origin is never presented as the event location.
Low-confidence or absent locations remain explicit and do not become map assertions.

eval_suites.name: citation-integrity
criteria: Every factual article and claim reference resolves to a source URL.
Evidence quotes are attributable to their article and remain short.
The capability never invents a URL, publisher, timestamp, or quotation.

eval_suites.name: cluster-coherence
criteria: Membership confidence and matching evidence are present for every article.
Articles grouped together refer to the same underlying event, not only a similar topic.
Conflicting coverage stays within the event cluster while distinct events remain separate.

eval_suites.name: abstention-and-failure
criteria: Empty data returns an empty result, never fabricated news.
Stale or failed ingestion is visible through health and freshness fields.
Unknown clusters and invalid filters return typed failure envelopes.
